role: post hoc current-checkpoint receiver reconstruction, not a new acceptance metric
selection: rank 4 of the 8 archived hybrid location errors
visual_style: Times New Roman; 2x2; white-background blue/orange wiggle gathers; OrRd absolute residual
display_scale: one common wiggle gain; no per-receiver normalization; no trace clipping or fitted amplitude/time shift
display_clipping: residual colors only: pooled FD/MoE 99.5th-percentile threshold, with extended colorbar; wiggle traces and profile are not clipped
